description.value: You grew up among avekiri who prioritized the collection of records and histories, where towering libraries or archives were prominently employed to track the livelihood of your lands and information was an ever-present resource. You gain the Eye for Numbers skill feat, even if you do not meet its requirements. You can cast the Quick Sort spell as a 1st rank innate divine spell once per day. When you reach 9th level, you can cast the spell at 3rd rank once per day instead, and when you reach 13th level you can cast the spell at 5th rank once per day.
